description: Header file defining structures, macros, and function prototypes for NVRAM variable manipulation in embedded systems.

methods.name: nvram_header
methods.description: Retrieves the NVRAM header from a handle.

methods.name: nvram_set
methods.description: Sets the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_get
methods.description: Gets the value of an NVRAM variable.

methods.name: nvram_open
methods.description: Opens NVRAM device and returns a handle.

methods.name: nvram_close
methods.description: Closes NVRAM handle and frees resources.

methods.name: nvram_safe_get
methods.description: Safely retrieves an NVRAM variable, returns empty string if NULL.

methods.name: nvram_calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC of the NVRAM header.

methods.name: nvram_to_staging
methods.description: Copies NVRAM contents to staging file.

methods.name: staging_to_nvram
methods.description: Copies staging file to NVRAM device.
